publication_sentinel_recommendation.preferred_surface: First-party RBA Media Releases RSS feed; direct linked endpoint https://www.rba.gov.au/rss/rss-cb-media-releases.xml, with the official Media Releases index as human verification fallback.
publication_sentinel_recommendation.matching: Match official decision-statement title/date to an explicit allowlisted Canonical occurrence and date window; verify the linked release page before candidate extraction. Never guess release URLs or infer event completion from feed absence.
publication_sentinel_recommendation.rights_and_robots: RBA RSS page explicitly describes software/feed-reader use; current robots rules do not disallow /rss/. Existing source permission for WSSRC-CB-002 is explicitly limited to bounded /schedules-events/ schedule paths, so a separate source/endpoint operational and rights review is required before activation. RBA general CC BY terms have Cash Rate-specific restrictions and attribution/non-endorsement requirements; this is an operational classification, not legal advice.
publication_sentinel_recommendation.stability: Official RSS link is a better candidate than guessed serial URLs; feed schema/retention/latency and firewall behaviour still require direct adapter preflight.
false_positive_controls: publication date matched to allowlisted occurrence
publication_sentinel_recommendation.candidate_only_result: A review candidate may carry rate, change and unanimity as attributed release facts; it may not mutate Canonical or promote to Live/Analysis automatically.
